notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (iaf-2026/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.training.time_budget_s: five minutes from the mission's start: the checklist by keys, the engine's wind-up and the INS stored-heading alignment (90 s) or the F-35's 90 s self test, with time to read the card
notes.training.end_hold_s: the mission ends 5 s after its goal: time to see the result before the debrief
notes.training.checklist: the start-up checklist by keys (training.md §7.1): the F-16's after the T.O. checklist's order, the F-35's battery, IPP, engine (AIR International, 2012)

footnotes.oa: OurAirports, airports.csv (public domain; LLRM elevation 2126 ft), https://davidmegginson.github.io/ourairports-data/airports.csv

briefing.en: Your F-16I Sufa stands cold on the apron at Ramon. Start the engine and bring the avionics up.
briefing.he: הסופה שלך עומד כבוי ברחבה ברמון. התנע את המנוע והעלה את מערכות האוויוניקה.

win.en: Mission - successful. The engine is at idle and the avionics are up.
win.he: המשימה הצליחה. המנוע בסרק והאוויוניקה פועלת.

checklist.en: Avionics power: ON, after the generators

checklist.he: ניווט אינרציאלי: יישור STOR HDG (90 שנ׳)
